narr: A fresh push of monsoon moisture fueled another round of thunderstorms over northwest Arizona. Several storms produced flash flooding and damaging winds.
ev: Oatman-Topock Highway was closed from Tule Dr to I-40 due to flooding.
Flash flooding closed North Estrella Rd from Chino Dr to West Estrella Circle and Agua Fria Dr from Milky Way Rd to North Estrella Rd.
Flash flooding in Dolan Springs closed 7th St from Sandra Dr to Mineral Rd and 1st St from Agua Mawsa Dr to Sandra Dr.
Route 66 was flooded 4 miles ENE of New Kingman-Butler.
West Cottonwood Rd was closed between mile markers 2 and 16 due to flooding.
